events.title: Ganesha Spirit Celebration with Jeremy Sol
events.description: An evening ceremony honouring Ganesh Chaturthi (September 14, 2026) — the annual Hindu festival celebrating the birth of Ganesha, remover of obstacles. Led by Jeremy Sol of Bhakti Bliss Bali at Alchemy Yoga & Meditation Center (AYMC), Sayan. Programme: 5:45pm sacred space opens; 6:00pm Maha Ganesha Kirtan (call-and-response devotional chanting); 8:00pm Prayer-field + Ganesha Pearls of Wisdom Storytelling by Sacred Fire; 8:30pm Closing Ritual. A one-evening ceremony aligned with the Ganesh Chaturthi festival cycle — not a recurring series. Tickets: IDR 250,000 early bird (limited), IDR 300,000 presale, IDR 350,000 day of event. Children under 12 free.
events.short_description: Jeremy Sol leads a Ganesha Chaturthi ceremony at AYMC: Maha Kirtan, sacred fire storytelling, and closing ritual honouring the remover of obstacles.
events.venue_address: Jl. Raya Sayan No.10, Sayan, Ubud, Bali
events.price_info: IDR 250,000 early bird / IDR 300,000 presale / IDR 350,000 door. Children under 12 free.
